summary: The change adds tests and doc comments only. src/engine/hand.ts changes only comments, so applyAction's logic is unchanged. The new test file tests/engine/illegal-actions.acceptance.test.ts uses no filesystem, shell, network or new dependencies. Out-of-scope check on malformed non-object actions (null, missing seat): no current caller can pass one. (1) UI: ActionBar.tsx:19 calls onAct only when action !== null, and its actions come from the legalActions-derived model. That goes through useTableSession.act to applyUserAction (session.ts:196), which also checks nextStep === 'user' first. (2) Bots: stepBot/actWith (player-view.ts:117) and the playtest runner (runner.ts:150) take typed SeatPolicy return values. (3) Replay: replayHand (runner.ts:263) reads in-memory HandRecord.actions. src/ has no persistence or deserialization path (no localStorage, JSON.parse or readFile), so no untrusted serialized action reaches applyAction. Even if a null did arrive, applyAction would throw a TypeError on action.seat before building any state, so it would fail closed without mutating anything. Declaring it out of scope is sound. If a future story adds save/restore or a replay-code import of actions, it should validate the shape at that boundary.
